title: Recorded precedent can preserve old mistakes
text: The compiler’s risk analysis identifies policy drift, incomplete capture, biased precedent and poorly governed reuse as dangers in decision histories. A prior exception should remain tied to its scope and authority; it should not silently become the default rule for later cases.
qualification: Explicit editorial synthesis. The proposed governance controls are reasoned applications, not results of a cited experiment.
